facts.fact: The report says Kenya enacted the Data Protection Act in 2019 and that it requires registration of data controllers and processors.
The report says the ODPC has been led by Immaculate Kassait for six years, until 16 November 2026.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: Kassait says individuals, entertainment venues, hospitals and public entities have been fined or warned over misuse of data during her tenure, with no dated or named decision.
